$comment: Host schema for a detection pack manifest (pack.yaml). Shipped packs, packs contributed by an extension under host/detection-packs/, and imported device folders share this shape. Directory name must equal id. Product rules live in docs/detection-packs.md; the contribution surface in docs/extend.md.
title: DetectionPackManifest
description: Manifest for one detection pack directory: pack.yaml beside rules/*.yml (and optional fixtures.yaml). id must equal the directory name (kebab-case). equivalents is authoring metadata only — the matcher never expands aliases.

id.description: Pack id. Must equal the containing directory name. Used as the import destination name (never the source folder name).

label.description: Short human label for Settings and cards.

description.description: One or two sentences explaining what the pack covers.

source.description: Optional. Provenance is inferred from where the pack loaded — a shipped pack, an installed extension pack's host/detection-packs/, or the device folder — and a manifest may only narrow within what its location already proved. Generated packs under the bundled tree set source: generated; any other claim stronger than the load path is reported and held at the location's own provenance.

equivalents.description: Authoring metadata (not read by the matcher). Maps a canonical binary name to drop-in alternatives that every Image list naming the canonical must also name. Feeds the Settings "also covers" line and a drift contract test.

generated_from.description: Provenance for source: generated packs. Each entry records an upstream URL, retrieval date, and licence. Required in practice for generated packs; omitted for hand-authored packs.

retrieved.description: ISO date the snapshot was retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD).

licence.description: Licence as recorded by the fetch step.

commit.description: Immutable upstream commit the snapshot was fetched at. Present only for git-hosted sources; a live provider endpoint has none.

pinned.description: True when the source is addressed by an immutable commit and its sha256 is enforced on every refresh. False for a live provider endpoint, whose digest is a record of what arrived rather than a guarantee.
